skill.name: generating-ai-actors
skill.description: Generates a photorealistic, fictional adult for use as an AI actor, influencer, presenter, or model. The resulting image can guide consistent identity across later media.
skill.summary: Creates a reusable fictional adult identity for consistent image and video campaigns.
skill.author: supercmohq

security_audit.summary: All six static findings are false positives caused by markdown backticks around tool names, models, dimensions, and status examples. The reviewed files show no command execution or semantic security threat.

static_findings.snippet: One `image_generate` call, `nano-banana-pro` at `3:4` unless the brief named a model or shape.
The image is polled for you, but it can come back as `{status: "pending", ...}` — a job handle, not
failure. Pass that exact handle to `job_status` to retrieve the finished image, and again if it is
still pending. **Never re-run a pending generation** with `image_generate`; that starts a new,
If it keeps refusing, switch to `seedream-5`. After a second rejection, tell the user which

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks format image_generate, nano-banana-pro, and 3:4 as inline markdown; the line contains no Ruby or shell execution.
The backticks format an example pending status object as inline markdown; no command or executable construct is present.
The backticks identify the job_status tool in prose; they do not invoke a shell or interpolate untrusted input.
The backticks identify the image_generate tool in prose and explicitly warn against duplicate generation; no external command is executed.
The backticks format seedream-5 as a model name in prose; there is no command execution syntax or user-controlled shell input.
The backticks format an error example and hint field as inline markdown; the line only instructs the agent to relay a tool message.

content.value_statement: Campaign teams need consistent fictional talent without supplying a person photograph. This skill creates one detailed adult identity that can guide later image and video generation.
actual_capabilities: Defines an adult actor by age, gender, ethnicity, build, facial features, hair, and styling.
Creates a wholly fictional person and explicitly excludes resemblance to real or public figures.
Builds a detailed environmental scene with surfaces, objects, colors, weather, and neutral daylight.
Uses casual phone self-portrait framing with realistic skin, grain, and an unretouched appearance.
Generates one portrait image with a default model and aspect ratio when the user does not specify them.
Handles pending jobs, safety rejections, likeness rejections, and missing provider configuration.
limitations: The skill generates one adult identity image, not a complete video or multi-image campaign.
Identity consistency depends on reusing the generated image in later generation workflows.
It does not create minors, real people, public figures, or requested likenesses.
Image generation requires a configured provider and may still reject some prompts.

use_cases.title: Cast a Campaign Presenter
use_cases.description: Create a fictional adult presenter whose appearance can remain consistent across product images and videos.

use_cases.title: Develop a Virtual Influencer
use_cases.description: Define a recognizable fictional creator with distinctive facial features, wardrobe, and a suitable everyday setting.

use_cases.title: Prototype On-Camera Talent
use_cases.description: Generate a reusable visual reference before committing production resources to a campaign concept.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic AI Presenter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a fictional adult AI presenter for [topic]. Choose a suitable appearance, closed-neckline outfit, and natural setting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when only the presenter role and topic are known.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Target Audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a fictional adult brand ambassador for [brand]. Reflect [audience traits] through age, style, expression, and setting without resembling a real person.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a campaign has audience and brand guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Distinct Identity
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a fictional adult AI actor with [features], [hair], and [build]. Dress them in [wardrobe] and place them in [location].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the actor and environment require precise creative direction.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Reusable Campaign Face
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one fictional adult identity for [campaign]. Include distinctive facial details, [brand palette], [setting details], neutral daylight, and casual phone-camera framing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the output will guide consistent identity across later image and video assets.

output_examples.input: Create an AI presenter for a financial education series aimed at first-time investors.
output_examples.output: A photorealistic fictional adult presenter in smart casual clothing, framed in a naturally lit home office with direct eye contact.

output_examples.input: Cast a virtual influencer for an outdoor skincare campaign.
output_examples.output: A distinctive fictional adult creator in practical covered clothing, photographed outdoors in neutral daylight with realistic skin texture and casual framing.

output_examples.input: Create a reusable spokesperson for a modern productivity application.
output_examples.output: A fictional adult spokesperson with specific facial and hair details, wearing a polished round-neck outfit in a detailed contemporary workspace.

best_practices: Specify the actor role, audience, brand context, and any required demographic traits.
Describe distinctive facial features and hair so later generations have a strong identity reference.
Reuse the finished image as the identity reference in every subsequent image or video request.
anti_patterns: Do not request a real person, public figure, or recognizable likeness.
Do not rerun image generation while a job remains pending.
Do not use this skill for complete videos, ordinary portraits, or product-only images.

faq.question: Can this skill create a real celebrity or public figure?
faq.answer: No. It creates a wholly fictional, non-identifiable adult who should not resemble any actual person.

faq.question: Can it create children or teenagers?
faq.answer: No. The workflow always casts an adult, including when a brief requests a younger person.

faq.question: How does the actor remain consistent across assets?
faq.answer: Reuse the generated portrait as a reference image in each later image or video generation.

faq.question: Does the skill generate a complete video?
faq.answer: No. It generates one identity image that a separate video workflow can use.

faq.question: What happens when generation is still pending?
faq.answer: The workflow checks the existing job until completion and avoids starting a separately billed duplicate.

faq.question: What happens after a safety or likeness rejection?
faq.answer: The workflow changes the blocked detail, actor, or model and limits repeated blind retries.
